training_design: Nested prefixes of within-action bootstrap draws. Fractions describe nominal draw counts, not new independent customers. Both model families reuse each sample; fixed evaluation customers and tie seed.
evaluation_design: Exploratory reuse of the previously inspected 12800 Hillstrom customers; no model tuning, selection, or claim of fresh confirmation.
simulation_design: Parametric fixed-policy experiments, not external or semi-synthetic validation. Exactly k=floor(N*budget) selected customers; iid three-action assignments with probability 1/3. Within selections, control purchase probability p0 and recommended-email probability p0+effect. Opposite-email purchases do not contribute to the incremental score. Policy is fixed before outcomes; no model is trained in these simulations.
simulation_bootstrap: Aggregate full-N iid row bootstrap is distributionally identical to the existing score bootstrap at equal propensities. Do not hold purchase counts fixed. Not a bootstrap within just the selected rows.
exact_reference: Within each homogeneous selected population, positive and negative IPW-event counts each have binomial(k,q) marginals. Combine two 97.5 percent Clopper-Pearson intervals by Bonferroni to obtain at least 95 percent coverage for 3*k*(q_plus-q_minus). Simulation reference only; not a validated replacement for arbitrary heterogeneous policy comparisons.
detection_definition: Lower endpoint of a two-sided 95 percent interval exceeds zero. Also report two-sided null rejection, coverage, bias, RMSE, width, and Monte Carlo uncertainty.
mde_definition: Smallest positive tested effect whose Wilson 95 percent lower confidence bound on detection probability is at least 0.80, using the conservative exact reference. Grid-based and conditional on the stated data-generating mechanism; no interpolation or retrospective observed-power claim.
